description: This file is a C source code file implementing a driver for the Data Encryption Unit (DEU) for the AR9 platform, including hardware initialization functions for AES and DES encryption modules, and related utility functions.

methods.name: endian_swap
methods.description: Swaps data given to the function; currently returns input unchanged.

methods.name: aes_chip_init
methods.description: Initializes AES hardware by setting control register bits.

methods.name: des_chip_init
methods.description: Initializes DES hardware by setting control register bits and executing a sync instruction.
